input.explanation: The division by zero is in this repository, in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py, inside `average_spend_per_item_this_month`. The patch fixes it there, before the division happens. `render_spend_summary` and `io_shop.account_page._the_figure_for` call this function and only pass its int along, so the new 0 reaches the page without changing them. Nothing outside the repository needs to change. Once this is deployed, monthly-spend-feature can be switched back on, and shoppers with no purchases this month get 0 instead of an error.
